mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10Y-2Y < 0) within the next 6 months, or GDP growth decelerates in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, indicating supply chain disruptions, will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies struggle to meet demand.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or INDPRO rebounds within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment, measured by the monthly change in UNRATE, signals a weakening labor market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines in the following month, or SPX returns positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, indicating monetary tightening, will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs increase for companies and consumers.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines in the following month, or SPX returns positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are rising, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either HOUST or RSAFS declines in the following month, or SPX returns negative in > 40% of instances where both proxies are rising.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is low and falling, it signals a tight labor market that will put upward pressure on wages, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies invest in labor.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises in the following month, or SPX returns negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is falling, it signals a potential monetary policy mistake that could lead to a recession, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS declines or CPIAUCSL rises in the following month, or SPX returns positive in > 60% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low, it signals a favorable environment for capital investment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either INDPRO declines or FEDFUNDS rises in the following month, or SPX returns negative in > 40% of instances where both conditions are met.
